newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears Bauma builder for public trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears Bauma builder for public trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission cleared an initial public offering of up to 1.2 million shares of construction materials producer Bauma SA and its 130,421 existing shares, the commission's head said on Thursday.
Investors can subscribe for at least 10 but no more than 100,000 shares of the new issue of between 750,000 and 1,200,000 shares on January 14-22.
The company, which wants to enter the parallel market of the bourse, had a net profit of 418,000 zlotys on 15.4 million-zloty sales in 1995.
